changes: Detached worktree creation uses the durable operation UUID and a fixed native HOME destination. Raw commit trees are fully checked before creation and materialized without checkout filters/hooks.
Read/attach/archive/restore require a supervisor-owned binding to the origin/common-dir/Git-dir/checkout identities; native journals cannot authorize paths or browser registration.
Archive moves the entire checkout with no-replace semantics, preserves staged/dirty/untracked/ignored data, repairs Git backlinks and never reclaims disk by recursive deletion.
Interruption preserves the complete checkout; explicit restore repairs validated fixed-location partial states. User locks, primary/shared/nested/symlink/hardlink/ambiguous trees are refused.
Native HOME is emitted from the fixed launcher cwd in worker environment. Previously owned units lacking that environment entry are recognized and migrated only after confirmed stop.

tests.command: HARNESS_TEST_PYTHON=<PYTHON> node scripts/run-tests.mjs --targeted tests/runtime/workspace.test.ts tests/runtime/workspace-witness.test.ts tests/gateway/receipt-result.test.ts tests/gateway/dispatch.test.ts tests/tooling/select-tests.test.ts

limits: No online service changes, real systemd operations, paid inference, external MCP or full suite.
Gateway registration, supervisor binding/witness and active reference checks are integrated separately by the root/runtime agents; this evidence does not claim their completion.
Native UID concurrent writes are not an adversarial isolation boundary. Worktree archive preserves rather than deletes content.
Source remains unfrozen. Subsequent skill/resource/download additions to shared dispatch files have separate targeted evidence; the archived Linux source digest identifies the exact tested snapshot.
